reviews.text:
They saved my dog emergency surgery they are very friendly and helpful
Reasonable price

Thank you so much for the amazing five-star review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We absolutely love seeing you and your two fabulous four-legged family members, Milo and Woody! 🐾🐾

They both bring so much personality (and plenty of tail wags!) whenever they visit. We’re so grateful that you trust us with their care and truly appreciate having all three of you as part of our hospital family.

Give those two VIP pups some extra belly rubs from their veterinary team! We can’t wait to see our favorite duo again soon! ❤️🐶🐶

The staff of Pearl Street Pet Hospital and Urgent Care

I had such a great experience with Pearl Street Pet Hospital. My cat needed some extra care and monitoring, and everyone there was so kind and attentive. She received IV fluids and had her bloodwork checked, and I really appreciated how thorough they were with everything.

Dr. Mandeville was amazing and made me feel like my cat was truly being cared for. She took the time to explain everything, answer my questions, and keep me updated on how she was doing. You can tell that she and the rest of the team genuinely care about the animals they treat.

My cat is back to feeling like herself again, and I’m so thankful for everyone at Pearl Street for taking such good care of her. They made a really stressful situation so much easier, and I would definitely recommend them!

Huge thank you to the team at Pearl Street Pet Hospital for taking such wonderful care of our puppy, Oakley! He needed ongoing care and bandage changes for a tail injury, and they handled him with so much patience and love. His tail is completely healed now, and we couldn't be more grateful for their wonderful staff and thorough care. Highly recommend!
Our boy means everything to us. Pearl Street Pet Hospital listen, cares, and took care of our baby. The vets and staff are professional and they have heart ❤️.  Thank you.
Thank you for the review, Stacy.  We are so glad we were able to treat Gilbert while you both were in town. Have a safe trip home!

New name, new location and new management. Dr. Mandeville and her staff at Pearl Street Pet Hospital & Urgent Care provided excellent care for my shepherd Marley. Marley woke up one day and she couldn’t use her back legs. We immediately rushed her to Pearl Street Pet Hospital. Dr. Mandeville and Dr. Wilcox and their staff performed a thorough examination gave us pain medication to make her comfortable to get her through the night and the next week. We brought her back the next day for x-rays and Dr. Mandeville explained that Marley could have a soft tissue issue in her spine but the x-ray she took could not tell her for sure and recommended that we take Marley to see a neurologist and get an MRI. The MRI identified that Marley had a herniated disc at T12/T13, she was put on a treatment plan and expected to make a full recovery. Thank you Dr. Mandeville, Dr. Wilcox and staff at Pearl Street Pet Hospital & Urgent Care for taking such great care of Marley. I will definitely will bring all my animals to see Dr. Mandeville as I know they will get the best care possible. Roslyn L

I’ve followed Dr. Wilcox, Shelley, and the team to their new facility and I’m so glad I did! They’ve been my go-to hospital for a variety of needs for emergency care when my dog had trouble walking to routine bloodwork for my cat. They’ve always been incredible kind, transparent, and knowledgeable. It’s been a privilege getting to know Dr. Mandeville, as she helped my family with my senior dog and having to make quality of life decisions. I’ve been able to get last minute appointments which I’m so grateful for especially with my busy schedule.  I’d highly recommend this team!

The interior of this vet clinic is superior and  is only superseded by the care our dogs receive there.  The medical treatments and kindness that our dogs receive at Pearl St is second to none. We so appreciate them and highly recommend. Thank you.
Thank you to Jamie and the whole team here! Have been taking care of our litter of kittens. Friendly, knowledgeable, and caring.

I recently took my cat here and was incredibly impressed with how well the staff knew what to do and how they handled her (she’s a bit crazy). Jamie helped answer all of my questions and made my cat very happy. Will definitely be going here again!

Pearl Street Pet Hospital has completely restored my faith in veterinary care after 14 years of disappointing and often heartbreaking experiences here in San Diego County.

I'm so grateful to have found them during the last few years of my dog, Betty's life. They were so incredibly caring to her. And so helpful- always being straightforward with information.

Just recently, we had to make the incredibly difficult decision to say goodbye to Betty. The team at Pearl Street guided us through her euthanasia with SO much love, kindness, and dignity. It was one of the hardest days of my life, yet they somehow made it feel peaceful, beautiful, and full of love. They treated Betty and us with so much compassion and respect.

With them, here is never a sense of being rushed or like we're just another appointment on the schedule. Their compassion is genuine, and you can feel how deeply they care. Every veterinarian, technician, and staff member we have met is warm, patient, and truly invested in the well-being of the animals they care for.

And honestly, the hospital itself deserves a mention. It is absolutely GORGEOUS. Beautifully designed, spotless, and incredibly welcoming. Most vet offices can feel stressful (and honestly kind of gross), but walking into Pearl Street feels more like walking into a spa. The calming atmosphere reflects the level of care and attention they put into every part of the experience.

We continue to bring our other dog to Pearl Street and continue to be blown away by the level of care. We recently signed up for one of their wellness plans, and it was a total no-brainer. For an affordable monthly fee, it includes so much preventative and routine care throughout the year. It's an incredible value and gives us peace of mind knowing our dog is getting the care she needs.

Nothing compares to Pearl Street Pet Hospital. If you're looking for a veterinary team that combines exceptional medical care with genuine compassion, this is the place. We are endlessly grateful for the love they showed Betty and continue to show our family.

Also HUGE shoutout to Shelley, Dr. Wilcox, Dr. Mandeville, Kendra and Phoenix! Thank you for all the loving care.

Kendra is a living doll with a huge heart .The doctor is beyond careful and kind she really loves her clients.Shelley really gives it her all and both docs have amazing hearts .We have an upcoming surgery so I will.update soon .

I recently had an emergency with my greyhound whilst I was on vacation and thank goodness I found Pearl Street Pet Hospital!!
Dr Mandeville was nothing short of brilliant , attentive , caring and explained everything that needed to be done all along the way! I wish I had this in my area, the hospital was clean, modern & beautiful but most of all the prices were reasonable and always explained the whole way through!! Many many thanks xx

Professional. It was busy because it was a Saturday. A few emergency last minute add ons. The communication was clear that they were busy and I did not feel neglected nor did our appointment time run too long. We were still in and out within about 45 minutes for a vet tech visit to get vaccinations for my dog. Shelley, Manny, & Dr. Wilcox are friendly, professional, & knowledgeable. Thank you all. Congratulations on the new clinic/hospital. It is beautiful!
Dr. Wilcox and the staff are amazing! She is very caring and knowledgeable. Our cats and dogs have all received expert care.  The new location is state of the art!

I called this hospital to check the price for my dachshund’s annual exam, and the quote I got was much higher than any other vet I contacted in La Jolla. I called around to compare, and every other clinic was noticeably more reasonable. The person on the phone was polite, but the pricing just didn’t make sense compared to the rest of the area. Based on that alone, I’ll be taking my dog elsewhere.

I have been a loyal fan of Dr. Wilcox for more than five years, following her from clinic to clinic because she is just that incredible. I am over the moon that she now has her gorgeous new pet hospital. Her team is equally wonderful. Huge shoutout to Dr. Wilcox, Shelley, and Manny for always making me and my fur babies feel safe, supported, and genuinely cared for. Worth every penny, and that is coming from someone who used to drive to MX for vet care. I trust them completely and I am so grateful for this team.
Thank you for your feedback—we understand pricing varies and appreciate you sharing your perspective.

I found Dr. Wilcox when she was at Kearny Mesa Vet after taking him to a different vet 3 times and them never figuring out why his paw was hurting him. She took one look at it, said there was a tumor in his paw and she removed it the next day.  After she left Kearny Mesa, I hunted her down in La Jolla because I now trust her implicitly. She really cares about the animals and she really knows her stuff.  The entire staff is also great and very caring and patient. They even painted a bunny on a bandage for me once because I asked for a cute bandage. They can always fit me in if it’s important. I’m very excited for them to have a fancy new office with parking!

Dr. Wilcox and the staff at Village Veterinary Hospital are the best. They will make your pet feel like a VIP- Very Important Pet. Staff is gentle, knowledgeable, professional and friendly. Dr. Wilcox is thorough and efficient. Olive looks forward to her next visit (kind of), but she will enthusiastically love to receive more treats. Thanks for the great care.

I came due to a promo for their new location coming, Pearl St Pet Hospital. The staff is very nice but when I got labs drawn, I encountered several issues. It did take a week to get a hold of the vet. I missed the initial call a few days after the appointment due to the weekend. I left a voicemail the next day and when I didn't get a call back, I called again and spoke with someone who said the vet was busy but would pass along the message. I asked for the results to be emailed but the vet wanted to speak to me before they released the results. I got a call back 2 days later (1 week after the lab drawn) to relay that both of my dogs had some concerning lab values. Since I had some doubts because clinically they didn't show any signs, I went back to my original vet to get labs drawn. The results were drastically different and showed that both dogs had no issues. There must be some quality control issues with their lab, so be wary.

For reference, these are the differences (11 day span):

Hematocrit - 34% to 41.2%
Platelets - 802 to 438
Triglycerides (non-fasted) - 835 to 80 (fasted)
ALT - 430 to 82

They were apologetic when I brought forth the issue, but through this experience I've spent $1200 to let me know my dogs are healthy, which at least there's that.

We love Dr Wilcox and Shelley at Village Veterinary! They are so welcoming, caring and communicative. I so appreciate the authenticity, knowledge and trust they exude. Always a pleasant experience- especially after having so many troubling experiences at other SD vets.

Great customer service & reasonable prices!
They are so sweet to our dog Jeeves.
They are also a value to the community.
They even held a free First Aid for Pets class at the La Jolla Library for Pet Parents.

I’ve had such a wonderful experience with Village Veterinary for my cat,  Boo. The staff is so kind, attentive, and friendly. Dr. Wilcox is extremely knowledgeable and thorough and Shelly, the practice manager, always remembers you and your pet by name and creates such a welcoming environment. After several not so great experiences with vets in the area I’ll absolutely be bringing all of my pets here.

Immediately everyone was so helpful and kind with a last minute issue as my dog ate something she should not have. They even went above and beyond to called the poison hotline because I had forgotten my phone at home, and handled it all for me. I am so grateful

I cannot express enough gratitude for the exceptional care that Dr. Wilcox and the entire staff at Village Veterinary Hospital provided for our beloved dog over the past year. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were met with warmth and compassion that immediately put us at ease during a time of worry and uncertainty.

Dr. Wilcox's expertise and genuine love for animals are evident in every interaction. She takes the time to thoroughly explain our dog's condition, treatment options, and answered all our questions with patience and clarity. It was clear that she viewed our dog not just as a patient, but as a cherished member of our family. Her dedication to her work and the well-being of her patients is truly remarkable.

The support staff at Village Veterinary Hospital, especially Shelley, also deserves a special mention. Each team member we encountered was friendly, professional, and incredibly attentive. They made our visits as comfortable as possible, showing genuine concern for our dog's health and happiness. Their kindness and understanding made a world of difference, especially during challenging moments.

Thanks to Dr. Wilcox and her team's exceptional care.with some solid direction and a loving support team we feel our dog will be better than ever in no time. We truly feel fortunate to have found such a wonderful veterinary hospital. We wholeheartedly recommend Village Veterinary Hospital to anyone seeking compassionate and skilled care for their furry family members. Thank you, Dr. Wilcox and staff, for everything you do!
Easy to get Rosita taken care of.
Shelly is a life saver when trying to calm my shepherd pup, who is scared of everyone and thing.  Especially when tools are coming towards his feet. Gadzooks! They are wonderful.!!!

Dr. Wilcox has been a true blessing to all of her clients! She is so kind and clearly cares about the animals. The manager Shelley is wonderful! They were able to get me in the next day when my dog was having a reoccurring ear infection. All the staff treated us like they really loved what they do and we appreciate it!!!

Very professional, excellent customer service.
Wort the 3 hours drive from home . Going back as much as my pets  needed. Definitely recommend
Our pup fractured his leg in the morning and they were sooo helpful! They took care of him all day and made sure he was comfortable. He is healing now! They even gave him the cutest cast.

I have a difficult 3 legged dog in which Dr Wilcox handled with compassion and expertise.   She sat on the floor with him and gained his trust before doing a routine checkup.  All the staff is professional and friendly especially Shelley.  I highly recommend Dr Wilcox

Dr. Wilcox and her staff are incredibly kind and compassionate. We are visiting from out of town with our dog, Bella. We took Bella to the beach, and she injured her paw, so we walked in to see if they could squeeze us in. Bella is  afraid of going to the vet, what pet isn't, but Dr. Wilcox and her staff used what she called "fear free" ways of doing her exam and throughout  the treatment. It's been a few days now and Bella is feeling so much better. Our family cannot thank you enough for turning a stressful situation into a good experience.
Village Vet far exceeded my expectations! Thank you for taking a caring and rational approach. I feel supported and trust your expertise. ❤️ Sage loves you guys too!!
Thank you , Dr. WILKOX AND STAFF. MY  Old old dog needed a rabies shot and  there was no appt wait...a coffee....free flea shampoo. Kindness and effeciency.

Brought my puppy here, while traveling through san diego and had an amazing experience! Such friendly staff and they took amazing care of him!
Will definitely be coming back, next time Im in town.
Dr. Wilcox is a great vet and took great care of my pup! She is thorough and provides great follow up.

From my first experience of calling in to the office to being met by the staff as I walked in I was impressed!
I was following Dr. Wilcox from her previous location. My dog, Porterhouse loves her and it was clear when he saw Dr. Wilcox enter the examination room how happy he was. The room felt very different from most vet offices - loved the toys.
Porterhouse was at ease. Huge for a terrier.
The examination while Porter was on my lap and being able to have a test for Pancreatitis with results while we waited was exceptional!
Congratulations to Dr. Wilcox and her top shelf team assembled. THANK YOU!
Photo below after we got home - healthy and happy !!

As a dog trainer I interact with a number of local Veterinarians quite frequently for referrals or consults on behavior challenges or training help. Not every experience has been memorable in a good way. This place however is really great. …
